theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ct_vs_compact_piece_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → ⨆ j, μs j K < ∞ → ∃ θ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono θ ∧ ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ K → ∃ c : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs (θ j))) atTop (𝓝 c)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
